proof.command: cd $LEGION_WORKSPACE && bun test scripts/conflicts && bunx biome check --error-on-warnings scripts/conflicts && bunx tsc --noEmit -p scripts/conflicts
proof.observed: 27 pass, 0 fail across analyse.test.ts (a built conflicting merge returns conflicts exactly ["packages/x/CHANGELOG.md"], a clean one [], two files sorted, other-branch kind, fix states before/transition/after, refused fix commits), summary.test.ts (window bounds, dedupe, prefix, tiers, per-file and per-glob counts, comparison) and measure.test.ts (CLI exit codes); biome clean on 13 files; tsc exit 0

proof.criterion: The comparison the production check runs works before the merge (P4)
proof.surface: the CLI with --compare-with the before records, live window since the Python run
proof.observed: exit 0, 37 s; before column 126 read / 80 carrying (63.5%) / 253 merges (2.01 per PR) / tiers 89 and 108, equal to P1's combined section; after 48 / 29 / 49; 373 file rows, one per file of either window
proof.negativeControl: --compare-with a file containing 'not json' -> 'raw records are not JSON', exit 2

trickyParts: Python's category table orders tied rows by set iteration (hash order); the port breaks ties by first appearance over events in order and each event's sorted paths, which matches baseline.md in both parts.
The Python file (no `selection` key) splits merged/other by `state`; a run of this script splits by `mergedAt` inside the window.
A --fixed glob's totals count each merge once (a directory glob would otherwise count a merge once per matched file); the comparison computes the before run's glob totals without git.
baseline.md as Dispatch stores it rewrote `__tests__` to `**tests**` and added blank lines; the reproduction diff normalises both.
deviations: Added per-glob merge/PR totals (summary and comparison) beyond the plan's per-file fix columns, because the spec counts packages/claude-envoy/legion as one group (25 merges) and the Production line needs it before and after.
--since/--until together with --from-json are refused (exit 2): the file carries its window.

The other section's tables are titled 'other PRs read' and the force-push section 'every PR read' (Python: 'open PRs', 'merged + open PRs'), since a live run's other set includes closed and merged-after-window PRs.
discoveredComplexity: The Python records carry no measured_at, so a comparison gives the before window as 8.00 days (through 2026-10-27T23:59:59Z) though that run was made at about 11:21Z; README says so and the comparison's shares are what compare windows.
